name: Gumroad
one_liner: Online sales platform for creators whose API lets developers act on a Gumroad account via OAuth access tokens.
auth_notes: Create an application under advanced settings to get a client ID and secret, or generate an access token directly for your own account. Access tokens do not expire until revoked.
access_notes: Creating an application and generating an access token are done in the Gumroad account's advanced settings. The help article describes no approval step. Cost or plan requirements are not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve access tokens and OAuth are documented in the help article. The endpoint list, plan requirements and MCP status are not on the fetched pages.

auth.quote: we do not expire the access_token until it is revoked manually

access.quote: if you only want to use the API on your own Gumroad account, you can manually generate an access token, which is a simpler process.

needs_human_reason: Plan or cost requirements and the full endpoint list are not on the fetched pages. The npm MCP page returned 403 and the gumroad.com/api page has no content beyond its title.
